:::{#def-logit-fn}

#### logit function

::: notes
The **logit function**  of a probability $\prob$ is
the [natural logarithm](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/algebra-exponentials.html#def-natural-log) of the [odds function](#def-odds-fn) of $\prob$:
:::

$$\logit(\prob) \eqdef \logf{\oddsf{\prob}}$$

:::
